content.what_it_is: Sponge and breakwater coefficient routines. SPONGE_DAMPING divides state fields by a damping array; ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC synthesizes incident spectral Eta/U/V then blends toward them; CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER and CALCULATE_SPONGE build Larsen-Dancy powers; friction and diffusion routines build tanh edge coefficients; CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER expands width-tagged cells into a global radial drag field and distributes subarrays with MPI (L47-L906).
entities: ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC with KK/K and Ein2D/Din2D/Uin2D/Vin2D around L76-L137
CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER with grid/width/R/A/SPONGE dummies, ri/lim and Iwidth around L148-L193
CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE and CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE with edge widths, scratch fields and decomposition coordinates around L204-L558
CALCULATE_SPONGE with Larsen-Dancy edge composition around L568-L740
CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER with global tmp_glob, radius/width scratch, decomposition ranges, gathered rank bounds and send buffer around L752-L906
calls: CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER calls four MPI_Gather operations then root-to-rank mpi_isend/mpi_irecv and mpi_wait around L849-L893
unresolved: SPONGE_DAMPING and ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC divide by SPONGE or SpongeMaker without checking positivity/nonzero values. CALCULATE_SPONGE intends coefficients at least one, but the arrays are externally supplied and the other coefficient builders can start at zero, so the consuming contract is not enforced.

All Larsen-Dancy exponent expressions use integer operands in `50*(index)/(Iwidth-1)`. Fortran integer division quantizes the exponent to steps instead of a continuous ramp, and Iwidth==1 divides by zero. The width-to-Iwidth conversion has no lower-bound validation.

CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER loops I=1:Iwidth without clipping Iwidth to M. A requested west width larger than the local/global domain writes beyond SPONGE; parallel ranks away from the west also execute that local range rather than limiting it to owned cells.

Friction and diffusion sponge routines accept R_sponge and A_sponge but never use them; their profiles depend only on global CDsponge/Csp and a fixed tanh length 10. The shared interface therefore exposes inert user controls.

All non-Cartesian width conversions and breakwater distance calculations use DX(1,1)/DY(1,1). Spatially varying cell dimensions make requested physical widths and radial distances position dependent, but the code treats them as uniform.

Parallel east/north distance offsets multiply each rank's own `(iiend-iista+1)` or `(jjend-jjsta+1)` by the number of remaining partitions. With uneven domain decomposition this does not equal the number of cells to the global edge, shifting sponge profiles by rank.

ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC imports Din2D and K/Stokes_Drift_Ser but never uses them. The absent drift correction may be deliberate, but the interface/import residue makes mass-current compensation unclear.

CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER allocates the full global tmp_glob on every rank although only rank zero initializes it. This is an avoidable per-rank global-memory scaling cost; allocation failure is not checked.

The breakwater MPI distribution assumes rank numbering `1:px*py-1` matches gathered decomposition order and sends every block with tag 1. That mapping is external to this routine and should be checked against the communicator/cartesian topology.
